title: Placeholder GP track/level definition
description: The shape tracks.js entries and levels/*.json files share — exactly what editor.html's Export writes. tools/validate-track.js enforces this plus geometry checks a schema can't express.

id.description: Unique across tracks.js + levels/. levels.js falls back to the filename if omitted, but set it.

medalAvgSpeed.description: Average race speed thresholds in m/s (raw physics speed, NOT the HUD's scaled km/h). Must order gold > silver > bronze. Calibrate with tools/drive-test.js.

controlPoints.description: [x, y, z] with y = real elevation, meters. Closed Catmull-Rom (tension 0.55). Note: car physics is planar — slopes are visual + slope-gravity only.

items.description: Free-standing placement splines. NO default bands are applied — one with no trackObjects places nothing.

trackObjects.description: Omit entirely on the main track to get defaults (full-lap barriers + curvature kerbs); the editor materializes them into editable rows on first open.

type.description: OBJECT_TYPES key (trackObjects.js): barrier, apexKerb, tireBarrier, tree, building, billboard, crowd, splineBarrier, splineApexKerb, splineTarmac, or cutout<Key> per ASSETS.spriteFolders entry (cutoutTree, cutoutCrowd, ...)

from.description: Lap fraction 0..1 (slightly >1 wraps on a closed spline)

spacing.description: Meters between instances (curvature-corrected). For ribbon types: texture tile length; for splineTarmac: meters per texture repeat

offset.description: Lateral offset from spline center, meters. Default: track wallDist. For splineTarmac: the strip center

conform.description: true = tilt flush with road pitch (barriers/kerbs); false = world-upright (trees)

scaleX.description: For splineTarmac: strip width in meters

tex.description: splineTarmac only: basename (no extension) of a file in assets/textures/road/. Transparent PNG = decal overlay

type.description: Same keys as bands, except ribbon types (band-only)

s.description: Arc distance along the spline in METERS (not a fraction — differs from band from/to!)

yOffset.description: Manual vertical nudge, meters. Building cubes are center-origin: band-placed buildings need their spline elevated ~0.7×scale instead
